mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase of 25 basis points or more in a single month signals a tightening monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline after a 25bp+ rate hike (t-test p > 0.05).
